lastCompletedStory.title: Add patterns.md author note for the two-clause exit-code idiom footgun

nextStoryContext: US-003 was a docs-only story: added a new bullet to scripts/cam/patterns.md immediately after the derive-don't-freeze bullet (patterns.md:903), explaining that the two-clause exit-code idiom (e.g. `git diff main --quiet -- file.ts; test $? -eq 0`) is flagged BY DESIGN by hasFrozenIntegerComparand's per-clause scoping (patterns.md:929): the derivation token lives in clause 1, the comparand tested against $? lives in clause 2, and per-clause scoping cannot see across the clause boundary. The note tells oracle authors to either keep the derivation token and its comparand in one clause, or re-derive the comparand again in the second clause, rather than treating the BLOCK as a lint bug to fix. No source/test files touched; all quality gates (typecheck, bun test 5249 pass, full bun run check:all spine including coverage/dead-code/dup/file-size/lint/ci-parity/agents-md/embed-vendor) green with no _ref bump needed (file not near ceiling, coverage unaffected). This closes the last story of the CAM-386/389 PRD (US-001 nested-quote fix, US-002 command-substitution mutual-recursion fix, US-003 this docs note); all three were independent (different concerns) and are now done.
